_about: Opponent styles. Each one adjusts the postflop tables in actions.json: betMult scales how often hands bet when first to act, raiseMult scales raises when facing a bet, and continueAdd is added to the chance that one-pair hands, draws and air keep going when facing a bet (sets and two pair are unchanged). Preflop, every profile uses the low-stakes pool charts for now.

regular.label: Regular
regular.about: Plays close to the default model: bets for value and some bluffs, folds weak hands to big bets.

nit.label: Nit
nit.about: Tight and cautious. Bets and raises less, folds more, so their bets and raises are strong.

station.label: Calling station
station.about: Loose and passive. Rarely bets or raises without a strong hand but calls with almost any pair or draw.

aggro.label: Aggressive
aggro.about: Bets and raises often, including bluffs, and gives up less easily.
